categories.main_business_segments: Shanxi Coking Coal Energy Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in coal mining, coal washing and processing, coal sales, power generation and supply, coking, chemical products, and building materials. The company owns 17 coal mines with rich coal resources and produces various coal types including coking coal, fat coal, lean coal, and gas coal. It also engages in power generation, coke production, chemical products, and building materials manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced coal mining and washing technologies, including intelligent and digital mining techniques such as 5G+ intelligent applications in coal washing, blending, and quality testing. It has developed key technologies for safe and efficient mining, gas extraction, and environmental protection, including patented sealing technologies and coal seam gas extraction methods. The company emphasizes green, low-carbon, and efficient production methods and continuous technological innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are large steel, coking, and power generation enterprises mainly located in Northeast, North China, South China, and East China regions. Key customers include major steel groups like Shougang Group, State Grid Shanxi Electric Power Company, and other large industrial clients. The company serves the industrial sector with coal and related products essential for steelmaking and power generation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Shanxi Province, China, with coal mining and production bases in Taiyuan, Gujiao, Lvliang, Linfen, and Yuncheng. It also has operations in other regions of China including Northeast, North China, South China, and East China for sales and distribution. The company’s resources and production are concentrated in Shanxi, a major coal-producing region.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanxi Coking Coal Energy Group operates primarily upstream in the coal supply chain as a coal producer and processor. It also extends midstream and downstream activities through coking, chemical product manufacturing, power generation, and building materials production, integrating resource extraction with value-added processing and energy supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on enhancing core competitiveness through resource consolidation, technological innovation, and digital transformation. Key R&D initiatives include intelligent mining, gas extraction technologies, safety management systems, and green low-carbon production. It aims to build a world-class coking coal enterprise by advancing smart mining, clean energy utilization, and expanding its resource base through market-oriented acquisitions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of coal products, electricity and heat supply, coke and chemical products, and building materials. The company also earns income from entrusted management fees and government subsidies. Sales are conducted via direct product sales to industrial customers, with pricing based on contracts and market conditions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the domestic coking coal industry, with significant resource reserves and production capacity in Shanxi, a key coal-producing region. It competes with other major coal producers and coking enterprises in China, leveraging its resource quality, scale, and integrated industrial chain. It is recognized as a stabilizer and key player in the coking coal market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 45.29 billion, a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.11 billion, and total assets of RMB 109.95 billion. Despite a revenue decline compared to previous years, the company maintains a stable growth trajectory with ongoing investments in resource acquisition and technological upgrades. It has a substantial asset base and continues to expand coal reserves and production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its abundant and high-quality coal resources, especially premium coking coal with low ash, low sulfur, and excellent coking properties, which are critical for steelmaking. It offers stable supply, advanced production technologies, and integrated services along the coal-to-energy value chain. Its strategic location in Shanxi and commitment to safety, environmental protection, and innovation provide competitive advantages and reliable value creation for customers.
